title: Vendor codec schema cache confuses nested field scopes and list item schemas
fault_primitive: ConfigMap-bundled Thrift decoder caches field descriptors by numeric tag and treats the list item schema as a fixed container extent
incident_class: Partial generated-schema and RPC runtime compatibility migration
symptoms: Timeline reads return HTTP 500, including empty results; post creation succeeds. All application pods stay Running and Ready. Edge logs show generic TProtocolException errors at the stock Thrift exception helper, with successful backend operations.
why_hard: The prior incident was diagnosed from a conspicuous init-container rewrite and repaired by Deployment rollback plus removal of a short schema normalization. This version leaves the Deployment asset copier, protocol enums, frame boundaries and generated files unchanged. The active decoder is a vendor-bundled module in the existing nginx configuration, shadowing the correct runtime file through the Lua preload registry. Two schema representation assumptions are wrong: field IDs are scoped to structs, and a one-element item descriptor does not prescribe list cardinality. File inspection and wire enum repair find correct contracts; rollback and pod replacement retain the ConfigMap source. The error points at the standard exception helper instead of the loaded decoder.
expected_agent_pitfalls: Roll back the frontend Deployment and assume the original asset copier restores the runtime
Inspect Thrift.lua and TBinaryProtocol.lua on disk and conclude the codec is correct
Investigate timeline datastores or post-storage because writes work and reads fail
Repair the endpoint exception handling or reduce requested timeline lengths
Fix container cardinality validation but miss field descriptor collisions on nested populated replies
Flush caches or restart backends without correcting the frontend loader
mitigation_summary: Remove the bundled TBinaryProtocol preload from the live nginx ConfigMap and roll the frontend to load the existing stock runtime. This restores per-message container lengths and unmodified per-struct field IDs without saved manifests or data changes.

SAYS: The nginx configuration overrides Thrift’s decoder with invalid checks on field types and list lengths. Those checks reject valid timeline responses and produce the observed HTTP 500 errors. I’ll remove the override to restore the bundled decoder. 
RUNS: /bin/bash -lc 'kubectl exec -n social-network deploy/nginx-thrift -- head -45 /usr/local/openresty/lualib/thrift/TBinaryProtocol.lua; kubectl get cm nginx-thrift -n social-network -o json > /tmp/nginx-before.json'
